data.gender_notes: Dharmaveer is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dharmaveer is recorded with the meaning “Dharma (duty, righteousness) + Veer (hero, brave)”. in_sanskrit.name: धर्मवीर
in_sanskrit.meaning: धर्म (Dharma) - law, righteousness, order वीर (Veer) - hero, brave, valiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धर्मवीर (Dharmaveer) - a brave and righteous person, a hero who upholds the law

in_hindi.name: धर्मवीर
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म (Dharma) - धारणा (dharana) - to hold, to bear, to support वीर (Veer) - वीरात् (Veerat) - brave, heroic, valiant
in_hindi.long_meaning: धर्मवीर (Dharmaveer) - धारणा करनेवाला वीर (dharana karnevala veer) - a brave warrior who holds and upholds the law

in_tamil.name: தர்மவீர்
in_tamil.meaning: தர்மம் (Dharma) - அல்லது தீர்த்தம் (Thiruttam) - righteousness, morality, duty வீர் (Veer) - கோபம் (Kopam) - anger, wrath, fury அல்லது வீரம் (Veeram) - bravery, heroism, valor
in_tamil.long_meaning: தர்மவீர் (Dharmaveer) - தர்மம் உழித்த வீரம் (Dharma uzhiththa Veeram) - a brave and righteous person, a hero whose anger is righteous

in_telugu.name: ధర్మవీర్
in_telugu.meaning: ధర్మ (Dharma) - దృద్ధి (Dridhi) - virtue, morality, righteousness వీర్ (Veer) - దేశ (Desam) - country, land అళ్ళ (Alu) - దేశపత్యస్ (Desapatya) - ruler, king, sovereign
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధర్మవీర్ (Dharmaveer) - దృద్ధి పోయుదు (Dridhi pooyudu) - a brave and righteous ruler, a valiant king who upholds virtue and morality

in_marathi.name: Dharmaveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (duty, righteousness) + Veer (hero, brave)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmaveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharmaveer signifies a hero who upholds his righteous duties and adheres to moral values. In Hindu mythology, Dharmaveer is a revered title for those who exhibit courage and commitment towards their moral obligations.
